about.title: Our Mission: Accelerating Your Mastery.
about.paragraph1: In the world of technology, knowing is not enough. You have to know how to *do*. Yet most courses stop at theory, leaving you with a gap between what you learned and what you need to accomplish.
about.paragraph2: **Katalyst** was created to bridge that gap. We believe skill is born from deliberate practice. That is why we built a unique learning platform that immerses you in simulated environments and real scenarios. You do not just watch, you manipulate. You do not just read, you build.
about.paragraph3: Our goal is to transform the way you learn professional tools, moving from passive assimilation to active skill acquisition. So that you are not only ready, but truly operational.
about.imageAlt: An image representing technology and learning

features.title: Skill through practice.
features.intro: Katalyst is built around a simple principle: the best way to learn is to practice. That is why we designed features that immerse you in real scenarios for accelerated mastery of the essentials.

interactiveSimulations.title: Interactive Simulations
interactiveSimulations.description: Dive into lessons that include simulators for immediate practice. Learn by doing, not just by reading.

safeEnvironments.title: Risk-Free Environments
safeEnvironments.description: Use built-in interfaces and terminals to manipulate tools in a secure environment, without fear of breaking anything.

clearVisualizations.title: Clear Visualizations
clearVisualizations.description: Understand complex concepts such as Jira workflows, AWS architectures or data flows through animated, interactive diagrams.

aiHelp.title: Contextual AI Help
aiHelp.description: Stuck on a task? Our AI provides explanations and hints based on your current state in the simulator.

skillTracking.title: Skill Tracking
